mapper.select: select * from cr_eval_test_instance_step where test_instance_id = #{instanceId} order by stage

select scheme.resource_id from cr_eval_test_instance_step step left join cr_eval_test_instance instance on step.test_instance_id = instance.resource_id left join cr_eval_situation_guide_scheme scheme on step.step_id = scheme.step_id where step.start_time is not null and step.end_time is null and instance.instance_name is null
